note: Every module that decides something a student or a gate relies on is mutation tested. A new file in one of these directories is in scope from the commit that adds it; the mutation-scope gate fails until stryker.config.json mutates it. A file is left out only here, with the reason.

except.apps/advocate/src/guide/taxonomy.ts: data: the barrier list, checked by the guide-feed and barrier-lifecycle gates
except.apps/advocate/src/guide/packages.ts: data: the support packages, each checked against the catalog by guide.test.ts
except.apps/advocate/src/eligibility/params.ts: data: published program tables, checked figure by figure against their sources by the oracle gate
